title: Document
description: Document file or text document with version control. Represents various document types like PDFs, Word documents, technical specifications, or any file-based content.

type.description: Document type or format (e.g., pdf, docx, markdown, specification, manual)

content.description: Document content or text (if text-based), or description for file-based documents

author.description: Full name of the document author or creator

version.description: Document version number or identifier (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, v3)

file_url.description: URL or file path where the document file is stored

created_at.description: Timestamp when the document was created
